subject: Invoice creation & delivery: portal opt-in with signed PDF copies for VAT purposes
messages:
From: Lena Fischer <lena.fischer@brightwellhealth.eu>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightwell Health AP <ap@brightwellhealth.eu>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +02:00
Subject: Invoice delivery & VAT evidence for PO 78431

Hi Hannah,

We've been asked to confirm how Redwood will send invoices for PO 78431. Brightwell needs: 
- A PDF copy (signed or stamped if possible) for our VAT file.
- An electronic invoice payload (XML/UBL) for our AP system ingestion.

We can accept either an automated push to our portal integration (preferred), or PDFs by email to ap@brightwellhealth.eu if portal setup will take longer.

Can you confirm the expected delivery method, whether Redwood can include the mandatory VAT fields, and the timeline to enable portal push? Attached is the PO for reference.

Thanks,
Lena Fischer
Head of AP Operations
Brightwell Health

Attachments: PO-78431.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lena Fischer <lena.fischer@brightwellhealth.eu>
Cc: Brightwell Health AP <ap@brightwellhealth.eu>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:03:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & VAT evidence for PO 78431

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear note and the PO.

Short answer: we can do both. Recommended flow and next steps:

- Portal first: we prefer to push the UBL/XML invoice payload into your portal (or SFTP endpoint) as a canonical source for machine ingestion. Our invoices include VAT fields (VAT number, tax breakdown by rate, invoice issuer VAT ID).
- PDF copies: we can simultaneously generate a signed PDF (digital signature image + signature block) and fan out to ap@brightwellhealth.eu for your document retention. This addresses your VAT audit needs while keeping the portal as the system-of-record.

Action items for Brightwell:
1) Confirm the portal endpoint (API URL or SFTP details) and a sample XML schema if you have modifications.
2) Share the VAT-registered entity name and VAT number to write on the invoice.
3) Confirm the AP contact for email copies (we have ap@brightwellhealth.eu).

We can enable a temporary email-only flow within 2 business days if portal onboarding will slip. Portal push usually takes 5–7 business days depending on endpoint/credentials.

I attached a sample-invoice.xml that shows the fields we populate — let me know if you need anything changed.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample-invoice.xml

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice delivery & VAT evidence for PO 78431

Kimberly / Connor — looping you in to confirm the approach below. Key questions:

- Is it OK to send a signed-looking PDF (signature block + scanned signature image) as a courtesy copy while portal is enabled? Any compliance or legal constraints on 'signed' copies for EU VAT evidence?
- If we push the XML to their portal, do we need to change our invoice-numbering or metadata? (They asked for mandatory VAT fields — sample XML attached).

Quick context: Brightwell wants portal push (preferred) but will accept email PDFs if portal takes longer. PO attached.

Thanks — Hannah

Hi Hannah / Connor — quick notes from finance: 

- PDF copies: Sending a PDF that includes a printed signature or a company signature-block image is acceptable as "a copy" for their VAT file. We should not imply a notarized/digital signature unless we have explicit signing infrastructure. Use a signature image and the signer name/title (e.g., "Authorized Signatory, Redwood Inference").
- XML payload: confirm they want UBL 2.1 or a custom schema. Our sample-invoice.xml maps to UBL 2.1; if Brightwell needs a specific element for "TaxExemptionReason" or similar we can add it.
- Invoice numbering: keep our canonical invoice number. Add a portal reference field if they require an AP-side ID.

Hannah — I'll draft the outbound that confirms the hybrid approach and asks for: VAT number, portal endpoint (or SFTP), and the AP contact person. I can send from finance or you can if you want to own the lane.

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments included on our side: sample-invoice.xml
